_comment: Newsletter poll config. PREFERRED: webapp_base = the Apps Script one-click web app (scripts/newsletter/poll-webapp/). The harness builds direct one-click links <webapp_base>?ep=<N>&vote=A|B|C&l=<label> and fetches <webapp_base>?mode=results&ep=<N-1> for the 'Last week's results' section. FALLBACK (if webapp_base is empty): the old reusable Google Form prefill links. Not secret.
